lesson.friendly_alien.title: Friendly Alien
lesson.friendly_alien.summary: Build a clear alien silhouette, balance a few features, then change the parts, expression and story until the character feels like yours.
lesson.friendly_alien.step.body: Begin with one clear body silhouette. The outside shape should read before any face or accessories are added.
lesson.friendly_alien.help.body: Keep the silhouette broad and simple. You can change the personality later without rebuilding the whole body.
lesson.friendly_alien.complete.body: The character already has a readable overall shape.
lesson.friendly_alien.step.face: Place the main face features with a little balance. Symmetry is a useful guide here, not a score.
lesson.friendly_alien.help.face: Use the center of the face as a reference, then decide how balanced or unusual you want the features to feel.
lesson.friendly_alien.complete.face: The face now gives the silhouette a direction and expression.
lesson.friendly_alien.step.parts: Add the structural parts—arms, legs and antennae in this example. Watch where each part connects to the main silhouette.
lesson.friendly_alien.help.parts: Start each limb from the body and let it travel outward. Connection matters more than copying the exact angle.
lesson.friendly_alien.complete.parts: The character now has a complete working silhouette.
lesson.friendly_alien.step.personality: Now change the character. Add or remove body parts, alter the expression, invent an accessory, marking, name or story.
lesson.friendly_alien.help.personality: Choose one detail that tells us who this alien might be instead of copying the teacher example.
lesson.friendly_alien.complete.drawing: Your alien now has a silhouette and personality of its own.
